conclusion: All 20 final Evidence/Activity viewport images and 10 immutable source images were directly inspected. No new P1/P2 rendering blocker was found in this bounded scope.
observations: The five-section local menu remains selected to the visible section. At 390 px it uses the shared labelled compact select; at 768 px and larger it uses horizontal tabs.
The relationship context rail is 316 px at 1440/1280/1024 px and is placed after primary content at 768/390 px, matching the source structural breakpoint.
Both themes preserve readable heading, selected state, actions and data labels without visible horizontal overflow.
The final Activity removal of duplicate introductory chrome restores first-revision visibility at 390 px while the existing Response history heading states the actual feature scope.

Source typography, blue prototype accent, fixed illustrative workflow values and source-only actions are adapted to shared runtime tokens and existing production capabilities; pixel identity is not claimed.
limitations: This is a named AI visual review, not user/product/design approval, exhaustive interaction testing or regulated operational acceptance.
The images are viewport captures. Content below each image boundary is not independently visually assessed by this receipt.
Synthetic UI fixture evidence and observed scoped reader requests do not establish backend authorization, tenant isolation or production permission enforcement.
The eight supplemental states are not covered by this primary receipt; they will have a separate receipt after direct inspection.
Automated visual-parity status is not overridden; this review establishes bounded source-anatomy adaptation and visible rendering quality, not pixel parity.
